exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System (RTGCS) group
Group 3 (multiparous, single, cephalic, term, spontaneous) with and without CD
Group 4a (multiparous, no previous CD, single, cephalic, term, induced labor)
Group 4b (multiparous, previous CD, single, cephalic, term, induced labor)
cohort: 7,247 women with severe maternal morbidity from 27 obstetric units in Brazil
finding: The RTGCS was useful to consider severe maternal morbidity, showing groups with higher CD rates and worse maternal outcomes, particularly groups 7, 9, 8 and 10.
mod_finding: Women in Group 3 who underwent CD had a worse outcome than those who delivered spontaneously.
